intro: Anthropic's stock fell nearly 6% in premarket trading Friday, erasing roughly $100 billion in value after its historic IPO debut the previous day raised billions for the AI frontier lab. A broader selloff across tech stocks is intensifying concerns about the sustainability of the AI trade, with Wall Street forecasters warning the momentum may be fading as higher borrowing costs and regulatory uncertainty weigh on the sector. Asian markets posted their worst week since 2020 amid the downturn, though some analysts suggest the market may be nearing a bottom after this week's volatility.
